findings.title: Approved dropdown hierarchy is not supplied
findings.finding: Application resolver produces flat entries regrouped under nine category headings. The renderer supports children, but approved 17 groups plus Approvals are not configured. Platform nav provides 11 top-level items and only Communications→SMS nesting.
findings.impact: Most approved submenu destinations are not available through the intended navigation, even where reusable routes exist.
findings.batch01_response: Added approved-order expandable groups with 61 verified static application submenu destinations and 2 property-context destinations. All 316 original entries remain below. Existing saved visibility, custom links and pinned forms are retained. Unsupported groups are not exposed as dead links. Platform navigation contains 8 functioning groups; the full 14-group requirement and unresolved Systetics reference remain in the ledger.

findings.title: Platform General Settings screen is absent
findings.finding: /platform is a portfolio/metrics dashboard. No global General Settings form, regional defaults, five tabs, required quick-actions/help/information composition located.
findings.impact: G01/G02 cannot be accepted as implemented by the current dashboard.
findings.batch01_response: Added /platform/settings for existing platform name and primary-colour persistence, validation, Save/Discard, breadcrumb, working settings links, quick actions and information panel. Existing dashboard remains. Platform-wide regional defaults and the complete approved five-tab/control composition require further work; regional persistence needs an approved contract.

findings.title: Template Library opens the wrong tool
findings.finding: Platform Template Library links to /platform/tenants/seed-templates, a lift-plan seeding/backfill utility. Tenant /apps is a generic Builder. Specialist Risk adoption exists separately.
findings.impact: The approved master catalogue/adoption/My Templates experience is not implemented by either menu link. Seeding must not be used as a substitute.
findings.batch01_response: Removed the false Template Library label from the seeding/backfill destination. It is explicitly Template seeding utility under Data & Integrations. Existing tenant form/risk engines are preserved. No unified master catalogue or replacement template engine was created.

findings.title: Tenant Manage modules edits navigation
findings.finding: Tenant Settings quick action goes to /admin/navigation (admin.nav.manage). Actual module entitlement controls live under selected platform tenant and cover five keys.
findings.impact: The label promises entitlement management but opens a different feature; settings-only users may also fail its separate permission gate.
findings.batch01_response: Manage Modules now opens /admin/settings/modules, showing effective entitlements from the existing engine. Navigation preferences, roles/permissions and property assignments are distinct guarded destinations. Platform Super Admin can follow the existing tenant-entitlements interface. No entitlements were changed during testing. Unit tests cover navigation and the existing entitlement engine; live persistence is unverified.

findings.title: Branding is incomplete and tenant logo is not passed into shell
findings.finding: Tenant form has logo, primary colour and letterhead only. Five branding tabs, accent controls, custom picker and full desktop/mobile preview are absent. AppShell receives platform branding while tenant colour is applied separately.
findings.impact: Saving a tenant logo does not establish the required tenant-branded application shell. Official default house/target asset is not guaranteed by code fallback.
findings.batch01_response: Tenant logo now reaches the authenticated shell through a tenant-context-only reader with private/no-store caching and versioned URLs. Added desktop/mobile preview, default fallback and reset/discard behaviour using existing logo/primary/PDF contracts. Tests cover reset/discard, current-tenant scoping, wrong-kind and cross-tenant asset rejection. Accent, email/login branding, full custom picker and exact approved preview/subtabs remain deferred. No standalone default logo asset was independently verified.

findings.title: Import capability differs from approved graphics
findings.finding: Property importer accepts CSV up to 5,000,000 bytes, not XLSX/10 MB. Drag/drop, file size/remove, preview search/pagination/download, full progress stepper and some result controls are absent. Errors block the entire batch.
findings.impact: Existing importer is a useful guarded foundation, but approved format/UI and inconsistent partial-import examples require explicit reconciliation.
findings.batch01_response: Preserved CSV <=5,000,000 bytes and whole-batch validation/confirmation semantics. Added dropzone handling, file size/removal, bounded preview search/record-type filtering/pagination and a five-stage indicator on real workflow pages. No XLSX, 10 MB claim, partial import policy, fake execution route or live import was added. Download Preview/Error Report and detailed execution-progress parity remain deferred.

findings.title: Module coverage does not match full taxonomy
findings.finding: Catalogue has properties, maintenance, compliance, diary and manager-signoff. Standalone Daily Hotel and Approvals destinations not located; Reporting duplicate and Systetics remain unresolved.
findings.impact: Do not imply every approved menu group is an independently entitled, working module. Approvals engine work remains outside Batch 01 implementation scope.
findings.batch01_response: Preserved the complete taxonomy without inventing additional entitlement keys. Approvals remains separate from Manager Sign-off and its engine is out of scope. Daily Hotel and other absent operational functions are deferred. Reporting and Reports are separate entries. Systetics remains unresolved. The audit contains 15 Platform Admin headings when Systetics is counted; it is retained separately from the stated 14-group requirement.

findings.title: Shared visual language differs
findings.finding: Default primary is teal, active menu uses white tint/Terra rail, and approved module-colour families are not mapped. Platform header lacks context/search/notification/avatar controls. Navy/light surfaces and reusable primitives already exist.
findings.impact: Structural and token discrepancies are source-confirmed; actual pixels, clipping and accessibility remain unverified.
findings.batch01_response: Preserved the navy shell/shared primitives and added blue active parent/child treatment and module accent classes. Added actual tenant search, account disclosure and Back to Application in Platform Admin. Notifications/search scope, exact colour-family matching, logo, typography/spacing and responsive clipping still require original-to-runtime acceptance. No global design-system rewrite was performed.

findings.title: Advanced and settings navigation are incomplete
findings.finding: Advanced route redirects to General; SettingsNavigation renders only four tabs. Import/Export declares an active section not present in the nav. Notifications/Integrations use distinct page compositions.
findings.impact: Route existence must not count as an implemented Advanced screen or complete settings navigation.
findings.batch01_response: Advanced is a real, permission-checked regulatory settings screen with an independently scoped, audited save action. Five primary tenant tabs are present; Integrations is permission filtered. Existing Notifications/Integrations functions remain. Import/Export and Modules are related settings destinations with no false General active state. Their approved full composition is not visually verified.

findings.title: Metric meanings and property models are inconsistent
findings.finding: Dashboard Modules is catalogue length, Templates is tenant form-template count, tenant General Modules is configured entitlement-row count. Platform tenant Usage counts legacy orgUnits site records, whereas property administration/dashboard use hospitalityProperties.
findings.impact: Counts are database-backed but are not interchangeable with approved enabled-module/master-template/canonical-property meanings. Reconcile definitions before visual acceptance.
findings.batch01_response: Tenant overview now counts effective enabled modules. Platform tenant Usage counts canonical hospitalityProperties rather than legacy orgUnits sites. Platform dashboard labels distinguish Module types and Tenant form templates from enabled-entitlement or master-catalogue counts. These are source corrections; no live metrics were queried or acceptance screenshots taken.

findings.title: Validation and permission alignment need targeted checks
findings.finding: General slug handler trims/falls back without an explicit syntax/downstream-reference policy established. Quick-action visibility differs from destination permissions. Platform tenant-language action accepts en/fr/es while tenant General uses shared locale policy.
findings.impact: These are concrete source review gaps; not demonstrated data leakage or a claim that all role combinations fail.
findings.batch01_response: Quick actions, newly supplied children and Integrations tab align with verified permissions. Added validation and deny-before-read/write tests for new supported settings actions. Existing General slug/downstream-reference policy and platform tenant language-option divergence remain unresolved and must be reconciled before complete acceptance.

findings.title: No runtime or rendered acceptance evidence produced
findings.finding: Audit inspects current source and originals. No authenticated runtime screenshots, mutation tests, role simulations, import runs, build/typecheck/lint or current-CI validation executed. Dashboard GET can call ensureSystemCards, so read-only browsing is not automatically mutation-free.
findings.impact: Source audit can support the gap inventory, but cannot certify deployed behaviour, pixel accuracy or tenant isolation. Nine required screenshot views and representative responsive states remain pending.
findings.batch01_response: 140 focused tests in 27 files passed; final affected branding/navigation checks also passed. Formatting and lint passed; the last added img warning was corrected and that component rechecked cleanly. Full typecheck exited 134 at the 2 GB heap limit. Production build was not attempted after the resource failure. No isolated database/browser runtime or actual application screenshots were available. No visual match is claimed.

baseline_audit.title: Uvanoo V1.4 — Batch 01: Code vs Approved Mock-ups Audit
baseline_audit.conclusion: The current implementation is not aligned with the full approved portal structure and graphics. Substantial reusable foundations exist, but navigation hierarchy, Platform General Settings, Templates, tenant branding and import UX have material gaps. This is a completed source/reference gap inventory, not rendered or runtime acceptance.

findings.title: Approved dropdown hierarchy is not supplied
findings.finding: Application resolver produces flat entries regrouped under nine category headings. The renderer supports children, but approved 17 groups plus Approvals are not configured. Platform nav provides 11 top-level items and only Communications→SMS nesting.
findings.impact: Most approved submenu destinations are not available through the intended navigation, even where reusable routes exist.

findings.title: Platform General Settings screen is absent
findings.finding: /platform is a portfolio/metrics dashboard. No global General Settings form, regional defaults, five tabs, required quick-actions/help/information composition located.
findings.impact: G01/G02 cannot be accepted as implemented by the current dashboard.

findings.title: Template Library opens the wrong tool
findings.finding: Platform Template Library links to /platform/tenants/seed-templates, a lift-plan seeding/backfill utility. Tenant /apps is a generic Builder. Specialist Risk adoption exists separately.
findings.impact: The approved master catalogue/adoption/My Templates experience is not implemented by either menu link. Seeding must not be used as a substitute.

findings.title: Tenant Manage modules edits navigation
findings.finding: Tenant Settings quick action goes to /admin/navigation (admin.nav.manage). Actual module entitlement controls live under selected platform tenant and cover five keys.
findings.impact: The label promises entitlement management but opens a different feature; settings-only users may also fail its separate permission gate.

findings.title: Branding is incomplete and tenant logo is not passed into shell
findings.finding: Tenant form has logo, primary colour and letterhead only. Five branding tabs, accent controls, custom picker and full desktop/mobile preview are absent. AppShell receives platform branding while tenant colour is applied separately.
findings.impact: Saving a tenant logo does not establish the required tenant-branded application shell. Official default house/target asset is not guaranteed by code fallback.

findings.title: Import capability differs from approved graphics
findings.finding: Property importer accepts CSV up to 5,000,000 bytes, not XLSX/10 MB. Drag/drop, file size/remove, preview search/pagination/download, full progress stepper and some result controls are absent. Errors block the entire batch.
findings.impact: Existing importer is a useful guarded foundation, but approved format/UI and inconsistent partial-import examples require explicit reconciliation.

findings.title: Module coverage does not match full taxonomy
findings.finding: Catalogue has properties, maintenance, compliance, diary and manager-signoff. Standalone Daily Hotel and Approvals destinations not located; Reporting duplicate and Systetics remain unresolved.
findings.impact: Do not imply every approved menu group is an independently entitled, working module. Approvals engine work remains outside Batch 01 implementation scope.

findings.title: Shared visual language differs
findings.finding: Default primary is teal, active menu uses white tint/Terra rail, and approved module-colour families are not mapped. Platform header lacks context/search/notification/avatar controls. Navy/light surfaces and reusable primitives already exist.
findings.impact: Structural and token discrepancies are source-confirmed; actual pixels, clipping and accessibility remain unverified.

findings.title: Advanced and settings navigation are incomplete
findings.finding: Advanced route redirects to General; SettingsNavigation renders only four tabs. Import/Export declares an active section not present in the nav. Notifications/Integrations use distinct page compositions.
findings.impact: Route existence must not count as an implemented Advanced screen or complete settings navigation.

findings.title: Metric meanings and property models are inconsistent
findings.finding: Dashboard Modules is catalogue length, Templates is tenant form-template count, tenant General Modules is configured entitlement-row count. Platform tenant Usage counts legacy orgUnits site records, whereas property administration/dashboard use hospitalityProperties.
findings.impact: Counts are database-backed but are not interchangeable with approved enabled-module/master-template/canonical-property meanings. Reconcile definitions before visual acceptance.

findings.title: Validation and permission alignment need targeted checks
findings.finding: General slug handler trims/falls back without an explicit syntax/downstream-reference policy established. Quick-action visibility differs from destination permissions. Platform tenant-language action accepts en/fr/es while tenant General uses shared locale policy.
findings.impact: These are concrete source review gaps; not demonstrated data leakage or a claim that all role combinations fail.

findings.title: No runtime or rendered acceptance evidence produced
findings.finding: Audit inspects current source and originals. No authenticated runtime screenshots, mutation tests, role simulations, import runs, build/typecheck/lint or current-CI validation executed. Dashboard GET can call ensureSystemCards, so read-only browsing is not automatically mutation-free.
findings.impact: Source audit can support the gap inventory, but cannot certify deployed behaviour, pixel accuracy or tenant isolation. Nine required screenshot views and representative responsive states remain pending.

implementation_inventory.observed: Request context; tenant-scoped layout; identity/context header; sidebar/mobile shell. Platform uses separate guarded layout and PlatformShell.
Registry + saved preferences/visibility resolver + nine-heading presentation adapter. Approved child hierarchy missing.
Renderer recursively supports children, separate link and toggle, active descendant, aria state; tenant resolver does not supply approved children.

Page/list/detail/wizard layout primitives, buttons/forms/cards, table and responsive list patterns; visual composition still varies.
Desktop collapse, mobile drawer and bottom navigation; source-only assessment, no device/viewport acceptance.
24 platform page routes inspected, including tenants/users/details/entitlements/branding/provider/log/database surfaces; global settings/master catalogue absent.
General/branding/import flow plus distributed admin routes; Advanced redirect; menu and settings shell incomplete.
Five keys, enabled-state/time-window policy, per-tenant operator changes/audit, three top-level nav mappings.
Platform operator vs tenant request context; tenant-bound DB and scope helpers; assigned-property checks; module-specific visibility. Source safeguards are not a runtime security certification.
Generic Builder and specialist risk adoption exist. Approved generic master/tenant management UI absent; misleading Platform library destination.
Property CSV staging/validation/confirm/execute/results and tenant export catalogue exist. People helper exists, but no active equivalent four-dataset settings flow.
